nodes.title: PDFKit v0.8.6 Vulnerabilities Summary: Command Injection (CVE-2022-25765) - Vulnerable to command injection due to improper sanitization of the URL parameter used to generate a PDF. Impact: Can lead to total loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability, local file inclusion (LFI), data exposure, and server-side request forgery (SSRF). Exploitation: PoC exploits are publicly available. Fix: Upgrade to PDFKit v0.8.7.2 or higher. Vulnerabilities related to wkhtmltopdf (PDFKit's dependency) - Directory Traversal (CVE-2020-21365): Can lead to disclosure of sensitive information if a crafted HTML file is provided. Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) (CVE-2022-35583): Can lead to a takeover of the infrastructure by injecting an 'iframe' tag with an internal asset's IP address in its source. Mitigation: Upgrade PDFKit to v0.8.7.2 or higher. Sanitize and validate any user-supplied input before passing it to PDFKit or wkhtmltopdf functions. If wkhtmltopdf is directly used, ensure it is also updated to a patched version.
